key_findings.title: Macro2 = SPP1 + APOC1 + APOE 共表达（髓系）
key_findings.quote: Macro2 can be defined by the expression of SPP1, APOC1, and APOE, and showed high activity in cholesterol homeostasis, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), KRAS, PI3K-AKT-MTOR pathways, which promoting tumor cell migration and invasion.
key_findings.impact: 首次在同一细胞亚群共测 SPP1/APOC1/APOE —— D3'' 的『APOE 共测空白』在髓系层面被打破；MGST1 仍为 0

key_findings.title: JCI Insight 空间个体级数据受 IRB 限制
key_findings.quote: The spatial transcriptomics data have the same restrictions, and the IRB has requested that we do not publicly share individual-level sequencing data. Aggregate-level data ... will be shared by lead contact upon request. Individual-level data are only available through collaboration following approval of the lead contact and the VUMC IRB.
key_findings.impact: JCI 不可作空间底图；仅可作单细胞参考 + 方法学范本（代码公开）

key_findings.title: JCI 已定义 APOE+ perivascular-like (APOE+ PVL) 基质亚群
key_findings.quote: We labeled cluster 4 as APOE+ perivascular-like (APOE+ PVL) based on its moderate expression of perivascular marker genes.
key_findings.impact: 提供第二个 APOE 锚点（基质 PVL），并已被纳入空间去卷积标签
